data.title: Why Is Arm Stock Falling on Friday?
data.description: Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM) stock fell Friday due to legal uncertainty surrounding its Delaware court trial with Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM).
